items.title: 시오노기제약, 슈퍼항생제 '페트로자' 美 조달…3690만불 수령
items.snippet: 시오노기제약이 미국 정부의 생물의료첨단연구개발국 프로젝트 바이오실드 계약에 따라 그람음성균 감염 치료제 세페데로콜의 조달 옵션을 행사하면서 3690만달러를 수령하기로 했다.시오노기제약은 28일 이 같은 조달 옵션 행사에 따라 자사그룹이 3690만달러를 받게 됐다고 밝혔다. 이번 계약은 지난 4월8일 미국 정부와 체결한 것으로 세페데로콜의 미국 내 완제의약품 생산시설 구축과 소아 환자 대상 원내 폐렴 적응증 확대를 위한 FDA 보충신약허가 신청 등 복수 옵션을 포함한다.시오노기그룹은 계약 체결 초기 단계에서 1억1900만달러를 지원받

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study to Evaluate Rocatinlimab (AMG 451) in Adolescent Participants With Moderate-to-severe Atopic Dermatitis (AD) (Phase 3, COMPLETED)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT05704738 | Sponsor: Amgen | Condition: Atopic Dermatitis | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: COMPLETED. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of rocatinlimab in monotherapy and combination therapy treatment in adolescent participants.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study to Evaluate TAR-210 Versus Single Agent Intravesical Cancer Treatment in Participants With Bladder Cancer (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06319820 | Sponsor: Janssen Research & Development, LLC | Condition: Non-Muscle Invasive Bladder Neoplasms | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The main purpose of this study is to compare the disease-free survival between participants receiving treatment with TAR-210 versus investigator's choice of intravesical chemotherapy for treatment of intermediate-risk NMIBC.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study of TAR-200 in Combination With Cetrelimab Versus Concurrent Chemoradiotherapy in Participants With Muscle-invasive Bladder Cancer (MIBC) of the Bladder (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT04658862 | Sponsor: Janssen Research & Development, LLC | Condition: Urinary Bladder Neoplasms | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. The purpose of study is to compare bladder intact-event free survival (BI-EFS) in participants receiving TAR-200 in combination with intravenous (IV) cetrelimab versus concurrent chemoradiotherapy.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study of Bleximenib, Venetoclax and Azacitidine For Treatment of Participants With Newly Diagnosed Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) (Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06852222 | Sponsor: Janssen Research & Development, LLC | Condition: Leukemia, Myeloid, Acute | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING. The purpose of this study is to assess how bleximenib and Venetoclax (VEN)+ Azacitidine (AZA) works as compared to placebo and VEN+AZA alone for the treatment of participants with newly diagnosed Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) with a mutation in the NPM1 or KMT2A gene.

items.title: [ClinicalTrials] Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (MK-2870) in Post Platinum and Post Immunotherapy Endometrial Cancer (MK-2870-005) (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06132958 | Sponsor: Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC | Condition: Endometrial Cancer | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. Immunotherapy is a treatment that helps the immune system fight cancer. This clinical study will compare sacituzumab tirumotecan to chemotherapy. items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Study of Icotrokinra in Participants With Moderately to Severely Active Crohn's Disease (Phase 2/Phase 3, RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT07196722 | Sponsor: Janssen Research & Development, LLC | Condition: Crohn Disease | Phase: Phase 2/Phase 3 | Status: RECRUITING.
